definition: Pichai Sundararajan (born June 10, 1972), better known as Sundar Pichai, is an Indian–American business executive who has been the CEO of Google since 2015 and the CEO of its parent company Alphabet Inc. since 2019.
details: Positioned Google as 'AI-first'; Gemini launch. Pichai began his career as a materials engineer. Following a short stint at the management consulting firm McKinsey & Co., Pichai joined Google in 2004, where he led the product management and innovation efforts for a suite of Google's client software products, including Google Chrome and ChromeOS, as well as being largely responsible for Google Drive.

explainer.lead: Sundar Pichai is a CEO of Alphabet Inc. and Google (born 1972).

contributions.name: In August 2017, Pichai drew publicity for firing a Google employee who wrote a ten-page manifesto criticizing the company's pro-diversity policies.

timeline.what: Receives the Padma Bhushan in trade and industry
